kind: FBI hate crime bias motivation codes: the reference for the hotfix decoder (Codex plan r1 findings 1 and 3)

sources.G2015: FBI Hate Crime Data Collection Guidelines ver. 2 (2015), FBI-Hate-Crime-Data-Collection-Guidelines-Ver-2-2015.pdf: printed p.5 (codes incl. 24, 41), p.26 (88 None, 99 Unknown)
sources.B2013: UCR State Program Bulletin 13-3 (Aug 2013) s.2.4, FBI-UCR-State-Program-Bulletin-2013-08.pdf: code 43 Anti-Homosexual changed to Anti-LGBT (Mixed Group) beginning January 2013; s.2.3 Arab and the added religions implemented in 2015
sources.H2004: UCR Handbook 2004, Hate Crime Incident Report form 1-699 (printed p.119), FBI-UCR-Handbook-2004.pdf, image handbook-p119-form-0.jpg: the pre-2013 list (no 16, no 28-29, no 31, no 61-62, 71-72, 81-85)
sources.DATA: local hate_crime.db by-year counts: code 31 present 1991-2003 (2001: 271, the post-9/11 rise), absent 2004-2013, present 2014-2025

beforeYear._rule: for a row with year < before, the FIRST matching entry (in order) gives the label and group; otherwise the modern label

sameMeaningOlderWording._note: older forms used different wording for the SAME meaning; the decoder keeps the modern label so one query matches every year
